notes: s.t is owned by o_foreign (created by the superuser; not assumable on PG16+). The plan revokes x_reader's SELECT. Without the envelope the applier has no privilege on s.t and REVOKE fails loudly. The envelope opens h_hold (it owns the altered s.u), which holds SELECT WITH GRANT OPTION on s.t, so REVOKE runs as grantor h_hold and revokes nothing.
